title: vtc-00 spec: Id charset, push example, lobbyState presence
description: Found implementing JMAP-8mem.1 (draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-00 at jmap-chat-spec 3227c0f). (1) L277 says the server SHOULD use the userId as VTCParticipant id, and the examples use ids like "user:alice@example.com" (L841) and "gw-pstn-14155559876"; ':' '@' '.' are outside the RFC 8620 §1.2 Id charset (A-Za-z0-9 - _). jmap-types Id does not validate, so the types carry them, but a validating peer would reject them. (2) The full VTCCallPush example (L1279-1291) omits channelId although L1273 does not mark it optional. (3) L315 says lobbyState is 'Present only when the call has lobbyEnabled: true' but the L851 example (no lobby) carries lobbyState: null; jmap-vtc-types serializes null. (4) The VTCCall/get example (L529) omits accountId (L345, not optional); jmap-vtc-types made VtcCall.account_id optional to round-trip it. Fix belongs in the jmap-chat-spec draft; crate follow-up only if the draft changes.
